name: 5662-batchdecode-dsv2litefp8-1gpu
model: yiliu4/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat-Block-wise-FP8-Test-Only -- ungated, 16.1 GB in 4 safetensors shards. The fp8 e4m3 128x128-blockwise weight format is required, and a per-tensor, per-channel, differently-blocked or bf16 checkpoint is not a substitute. Labelled `Test-Only` with no published accuracy, so the generated text is not a health signal.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU. sm90 is part of the setup and not incidental: this release reads `get_device_sm()` at import and gates code on the value being exactly 90, so an Ada or Blackwell card is a different setup rather than a slower one.
parallelism: tp1 -- all 16 attention heads on the one rank, no collective communication.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, hidden 2048, 16 attention heads; MLA with kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, qk_nope_head_dim 128, v_head_dim 128, q_lora_rank null; MoE with 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, moe_intermediate_size 1408, first_k_dense_replace 1; 15.7B total / 2.4B active; weights fp8 e4m3 blockwise 128x128, compute bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 960 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 256 prompt and 512 output tokens, stdev 0 on both, seed 42, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` set through `backend.extras.body`. The pinned output length is load-bearing: without it requests differ in how much work they do and not only in how fast they do it.
purpose: A compact mixture-of-experts chat assistant answering 32 concurrent users with short prompts and long replies on one GPU.
launch:
model-path: yiliu4/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat-Block-wise-FP8-Test-Only
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true

# HAZARD: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and the device-side request table is
# (max requests) x (context length + 8) int32 -- at the advertised window that is terabytes and the
# server never starts. 4096 is the native window and the longest request here is 256 + 512 = 768.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
